verdict.rationale: Whisper ships as an open GitHub package you install with pip and run locally, via a CLI or Python with multiple model sizes. Community reports confirm running it on users' own hardware, including the whisper.cpp port on a Mac and on low-spec devices. Users note that larger models are slow without a CUDA GPU. Missing for 10: evidence of the license terms permitting self-hosting, first-party hardware/deployment guidance (e.g., GPU requirements, serving setup).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: You can download and install (or update to) the latest release of Whisper with the following command: pip install -U openai-whisper
Transcription can also be performed within Python: model = whisper.load_model("turbo") result = model.transcribe("audio.mp3")
The following command will transcribe speech in audio files, using the `turbo` model: whisper audio.flac audio.mp3 audio.wav --model turbo
A user cloned the whisper.cpp repo on an Apple Silicon Mac and ran the streaming sample, which 'worked flawlessly.'
